title: Concept: Apache access log served as a response
description: The access log shows which endpoints exist and which ones failed, together with the client addresses and the user agents that reached them. It maps the application for the caller and, where query strings are logged, it records the parameters other users sent.
applicability: Responses that serve a log directory from the web root.
risk: The caller maps the application, learns which paths exist, and reads query strings that may carry tokens.
